name: calibration-probe-collector
description: Cloudflare Worker that collects opt-in probe results from the public calibration probe

scripts.db:stats: wrangler d1 execute probe-results --command="SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(has_signal) as with_signal, SUM(underpowered) as underpowered, SUM(no_failures) as no_failures FROM submissions"
scripts.db:models: wrangler d1 execute probe-results --command="SELECT * FROM v_model_stats"
